description: Find pages similar to a given URL using neural/semantic matching. Returns title, URL, relevance score, and published date. Example: find_similar({ url: "https://example.com/great-article", num_results: 10 })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Exa API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

num_results.description: Number of results to return (default 10, max 25)

url.description: The URL to find semantically similar pages for.

name: find_similar
